text:
There is a profound, tragic comedy in the life of a three-pound dog who takes a "Beware of Dog" sign personally. Imagine the sheer audacity of a creature that fits in a purse, sprinting out to defend its territory against the postal service. The postman’s reaction—feigning terror—is the cherry on top of this absurd sundae. It’s the universal experience of realizing your pet has zero self-awareness and maximum confidence. Now, that tiny furball is on a relentless quest to prove the postman wrong, likely by barking at his own shadow or trying to intimidate a leaf. It’s a reminder that bravery isn’t about size; it’s about having a sign that says you’re dangerous when you’re basically a fluffy marshmallow.

The color of an eggplant is purple.
